name: archtoolkit
description: Offline-first architecture toolkit: multi-cloud decision logic, application migration, VMware inventory, VCF 9.1 sizing and spec generation, Terraform authoring, Ansible authoring, network device configuration.
author: Theodore Gibson

comments.dependencies: Intentionally none. The toolkit must run in air-gapped environments with no package registry. TypeScript is compiled by Node's built-in type stripper (tools/build.mjs); tests run on node:test. The only optional dev tool is tsc for full type checking, which is not required to build or run.
